title: Senior Executive – Operations & Pricing (Sea & Air Freight)- freight forwarding
description:
SCM BPO is looking for an experienced Senior Executive – Operations & Pricing with strong expertise in both Sea and Air Freight operations and pricing.

The ideal candidate should have hands-on experience in coordinating international shipments, handling freight operations, negotiating rates with carriers and agents, preparing competitive quotations, and ensuring smooth end-to-end shipment execution.

Key Responsibilities

**1. Sea & Air Freight Operations**

* Manage end-to-end import and export operations for Sea and Air Freight shipments.
* Coordinate with shipping lines, airlines, overseas agents, customs brokers, transporters and customers.
* Handle shipment bookings, documentation, cargo tracking and delivery coordination.
* Monitor shipment milestones and ensure timely updates to customers.
* Resolve operational issues, delays and shipment-related escalations.
* Ensure accurate documentation and compliance with applicable shipping procedures.

**2. Freight Pricing & Quotation**

* Obtain and negotiate competitive freight rates with shipping lines, airlines and overseas agents.
* Prepare and share quotations for Sea and Air Freight enquiries.
* Handle FCL, LCL and Air Freight pricing requirements.
* Evaluate freight costs, surcharges, transit times and routing options.
* Maintain updated rate sheets and pricing databases.
* Coordinate with the sales and business development teams to support customer enquiries and business opportunities.
* Identify cost-effective routing and pricing solutions while maintaining profitability.

**3. Coordination & Customer Support**

* Maintain effective communication with international agents, carriers and customers.
* Follow up on shipment status, bookings, rates and operational requirements.
* Provide timely solutions to customer queries and operational challenges.
* Maintain accurate shipment records, quotations and operational reports.

Required Skills & Qualifications

* Bachelor's degree or relevant qualification in Logistics, Supply Chain Management or a related field.
* 4–7 years of relevant experience in the freight forwarding industry.
* Strong hands-on experience in both Sea and Air Freight operations.
* Practical knowledge of FCL, LCL, import and export processes.
* Proven experience in freight pricing, rate negotiation and quotation preparation.
* Good understanding of shipping documentation, freight charges and surcharges.
* Experience coordinating with international agents, shipping lines and airlines.
* Strong communication, negotiation and coordination skills.
* Ability to manage multiple shipments and pricing enquiries simultaneously.

Preferred Candidate Profile

* Candidates with combined Sea and Air Freight Operations and Pricing experience will be preferred.
* Candidates with experience in international freight forwarding and overseas agent coordination will have an added advantage.
* Candidates currently working with freight forwarding companies, NVOCCs or logistics service providers are encouraged to apply.

Pay: ₹35,000.00 - ₹50,000.00 per month

Application Question(s):

* How many years of experience do you have in the freight forwarding industry?
* How many years of hands-on experience do you have in Sea Freight and Air Freight separately?

title: Sales Executive- Soft Tissue Implant- Thrissur
description:
Careers that change lives start here. Medtronic is a global leader in healthcare technology with a Mission to alleviate pain, restore health, and extend life. Our 95,000 employees work across more than 150 countries to put patients first — developing innovative medical technologies that improve the lives of 72+ million patients each year. Your unique talents will help shape the future of healthcare while building a career grounded in purpose, growth, and impact.

**A Day in the Life**
=====================

Medtronic’s Soft Tissue Implants (STI) business provides implantable solutions used to repair, reinforce, and support soft tissue during surgery. The portfolio includes products for hernia repair, abdominal wall reconstruction, wound closure, and other soft tissue reinforcement applications. The business partners closely with surgeons, hospitals, and operating room teams by delivering clinically supported technologies that help improve procedural outcomes and patient care.
  
  
This field-based sales role supports the STI portfolio across Thrissur and the surrounding territory. The position is primarily customer-facing, requiring regular engagement with hospitals, surgical teams, and healthcare stakeholders. This role requires travel of up to 30% within the assigned territory to support account development, clinical case coverage, customer training, and business growth initiatives.
  
  
The sales executive Soft Tissue Implants is responsible for driving portfolio adoption and achieving sales objectives within the assigned territory. This role partners with surgeons, operating room staff, hospital administration, and procurement stakeholders to expand product utilization, provide clinical support, and develop long-term customer relationships across assigned accounts.  
  

Responsibilities may include the following and other duties may be assigned.

* Achieve territory sales targets and revenue objectives for the Soft Tissue Implants portfolio.
* Drive growth of Hernia Solutions and Suture products across hospitals, referral centers, and healthcare institutions.
* Provide surgical case coverage, product demonstrations, and clinical support during procedures.
* Conduct product training, therapy education, and account onboarding for new and existing customers.
* Develop and execute territory plans to increase account penetration, product utilization, and market share.
* Build relationships with surgeons, nurses, hospital administrators, and purchasing stakeholders to support business growth.
* Gather competitive intelligence, customer insights, and market information to support territory strategies.
Maintain compliance with company policies, quality standards, reporting requirements, and customer engagement guidelines.  

  

**Required Qualifications**

High School Diploma (or equivalent) AND 4+ years’ experience OR Associate’s Degree AND 2+ years’ experience OR Bachelor’s Degree Experience managing hospital-based sales and customer relationships within assigned territories.  

  

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience supporting clinical procedures, product evaluations, or healthcare professional training programs.
* Demonstrated track record of achieving sales targets and growing business within healthcare accounts.
* Ability to travel up to 30% within the assigned territory.
* Experience selling hernia repair products, sutures, implantable medical devices, or soft tissue repair solutions.
* Experience providing operating room support and assisting surgeons during procedures.
* Knowledge of hospital procurement processes, committee approvals, and healthcare purchasing pathways.
* Experience conducting clinical education programs, product demonstrations, and in-service training.
Experience converting competitive accounts and expanding product adoption across healthcare institutions.  

  

**Physical Job Requirements**

Apply only through official Medtronic channels. All legitimate Medtronic recruiting communications come from approved Medtronic platforms and official @medtronic.com email addresses.

description:
**Founding Team | Nebula Finance AI**

**Location:** Manjeri, Kerala, India (Internship Period)  
**Employment Structure:** Six-month internship, with the opportunity for full-time employment based on performance and business requirements.  
**Reporting to:** Founder  
**Travel:** Regular travel to client locations and major Indian cities as required.

About Nebula Finance AI

**Nebula Finance AI** is an emerging financial technology company building an AI-powered finance workflow and intelligence platform for corporate clients in India.

**Developed by AI engineers from Great Britain**, our platform is designed to transform how corporate finance and treasury teams manage financial workflows, access insights, evaluate financial decisions, and automate repetitive processes.

Our solutions focus on practical applications across corporate treasury and finance, including cash and liquidity management, foreign exchange exposure and hedging, debt management, investments, receivables analysis, and AI-assisted financial decision-making.

By connecting financial data, business systems, banking workflows, and AI-powered intelligence, Nebula aims to help organizations improve efficiency, visibility, risk management, and the quality of financial decisions.

We have completed pilot testing with two major corporate organizations in India and are preparing to commence commercial operations with a planned launch in January 2027.

This is an opportunity to join Nebula at its earliest stage and help shape its commercial journey from the ground up.

About the Role

We are looking for an exceptionally ambitious, enthusiastic and commercially driven individual to join our founding team as a **Business Development Associate – Finance & AI**.

This opportunity is designed for someone who wants to build a career at the intersection of corporate finance, financial technology, artificial intelligence and enterprise business development.

The successful candidate will initially join Nebula as an intern for six months, working closely with the Founder and the business development team. During this period, the individual will receive practical exposure to corporate finance, enterprise technology sales, AI-powered financial solutions and senior-level client engagement.

This is not a conventional internship involving administrative work or observation. From the beginning, you will be **actively** **involved in researching corporate clients, identifying business opportunities, reaching out to decision-makers, arranging meetings, conducting product demonstrations and supporting the sales process.**

As you develop an understanding of our platform, customers and market, you will progressively be **expected to take ownership of the complete sales lifecycle**, from identifying a prospective customer to securing the business and supporting the client after onboarding.

Candidates who demonstrate exceptional performance, initiative and commercial ability will have the opportunity to transition into a full-time position and take on greater responsibilities as Nebula expands.

What We Are Looking For

We are looking for someone with the following qualities and capabilities:

1. Ambition, Passion and Work Ethic

* A highly passionate, ambitious and self-motivated individual with a strong desire to build a successful career.
* Willingness to work hard, take ownership of responsibilities and go beyond assigned tasks when required.
* Ability to work in a demanding, fast-paced startup environment where priorities and responsibilities may evolve.
* A strong sense of accountability, discipline and commitment to achieving business objectives.

2. Interest in Financial Technology and AI

* A genuine interest in financial technology, artificial intelligence, machine learning, automation and enterprise software.
* Curiosity about how technology can transform corporate finance and treasury operations.
* Willingness to understand the technical capabilities of the Nebula platform and communicate its value to prospective customers.
* An interest in understanding software development, coding concepts, APIs, databases and AI applications would be an advantage.

3. Innovative and Analytical Thinking

* Ability to think independently and approach business challenges creatively.
* Willingness to challenge conventional approaches and suggest new ways of identifying and engaging potential customers.
* Ability to connect business problems with technology-based solutions.
* Strong problem-solving skills and an innovative, out-of-the-box approach to business development.

4. Communication and Presentation Skills

* **Excellent command of the English language, both spoken and written**. This is a non-negotiable requirement.
* Confidence in communicating with senior professionals and corporate decision-makers.
* Ability to prepare professional emails, business presentations, proposals and research reports.
* Strong presentation skills and the ability to explain complex financial and technological concepts in a simple and convincing manner.

5. Market Research and Business Intelligence

* Conduct in-depth research into the Indian corporate finance and financial technology market.
* Identify prospective corporate clients, understand their business operations and assess their potential requirements.
* Research competitors, their products, pricing, market positioning and commercial strategies.
* Apply analytical frameworks and business research techniques, including MBA-level strategic analysis such as SWOT, PESTLE, Porter's Five Forces, competitor benchmarking and market segmentation.
* Develop target-client databases and identify potential entry points into large corporate organizations.
* Present research findings and actionable recommendations to the Founder.

6. Sales and Business Development

This will be a core responsibility of the position.

* Identify and approach prospective corporate customers through cold calling, email outreach, LinkedIn and other professional channels.
* Establish initial contact with CFOs, CEOs, Treasurers, Finance Directors and other relevant stakeholders.
* Arrange business meetings, coordinate appointments and maintain continuous engagement with prospective clients.
* Understand customer requirements and identify opportunities where Nebula can offer practical solutions.
* Conduct platform demonstrations and explain the commercial and operational benefits of Nebula's solutions.
* Prepare and follow up on proposals, presentations and commercial discussions.
* Maintain a structured sales pipeline and ensure timely follow-ups.
* Support negotiations and work towards converting opportunities into paying customers.
* Assist with client onboarding, training, relationship management and after-sales support.

**The ultimate expectation is that, within the first few months, you should progressively develop the ability to independently manage the complete sales lifecycle, from prospect identification and initial engagement to product demonstration, commercial closure and after-sales relationship management.**

7. Technical and Product Understanding

* Develop an in-depth understanding of Nebula's platform, modules and technical capabilities.
* Learn how the platform interacts with corporate finance systems, banking data, ERP platforms and other financial applications.
* Work with the technical team to understand customer requirements and communicate them effectively.
* Participate in product testing, demonstrations and customer feedback sessions.
* Develop the ability to explain the practical application of AI and automation in corporate finance.

8. Mobility and Travel

* **Willingness to relocate temporarily to Manjeri, Kerala, for a few months**, as the Founder will be based there during the initial business development phase.
* Willingness to travel to client locations and major business centers across India.
* A valid driving license is mandatory.
* Flexibility to work from other business locations as the company expands.

Qualifications and Eligibility

* Graduate in Finance, Commerce, Economics, Business Administration or a related discipline.
* **MBA in Finance, Marketing, Business Management or a related field is preferred**.
* Fresh graduates and candidates with limited professional experience are encouraged to apply.
* Candidates with exposure to corporate finance, banking, financial markets, fintech, technology sales or business development will have an advantage.
* Familiarity with Microsoft Office, Excel, PowerPoint and professional business communication is expected.
* Exposure to AI tools, coding, Python, SQL, APIs or software applications will be an added advantage.

**We value capability, ambition, communication and the willingness to learn more than academic qualifications alone.**

What We Offer1. Accelerated Career Development

An opportunity to build your career within an emerging financial technology company from its earliest stage. Career progression will be based on individual performance, contribution and the company's growth.

2. Direct Exposure to Industry Leaders

Opportunities to engage and interact with CFOs, CEOs, Group Treasurers, Finance Directors and other senior executives of large corporate organizations.

3. Enterprise Business Development Experience

Practical experience in enterprise sales, financial technology demonstrations, corporate client acquisition, commercial negotiations and business relationship management.

4. Business Travel Opportunities

Opportunities to travel to corporate client locations across India and participate in business meetings and engagements with senior corporate executives.

5. Industry Conferences and Networking

Opportunity to attend relevant financial technology, corporate finance and treasury conferences, seminars and industry events based on individual performance and business requirements.

6. Direct Mentorship from the Founder

Work closely with the Founder and gain practical exposure to business strategy, corporate finance, technology development, commercial negotiations and startup management.

7. Internship Stipend and Full-Time Opportunity

* A monthly stipend will be provided during the six-month internship.
* Subject to satisfactory performance and business requirements, the candidate may be offered a full-time position upon successful completion of the internship.
* The full-time position will carry revised compensation and increased responsibilities, as mutually agreed.

Six-Month Internship – Expected Progression

The internship is structured to help you transition from a learner into an independent business development professional.

Application Process

Interested candidates should submit:

* An updated CV/resume.
* A recent passport-size photograph.
* A short cover letter explaining why they want to join Nebula Finance AI and what makes them suitable for this opportunity.
* Details of any relevant academic projects, internships, certifications, coding experience or extracurricular achievements.

Shortlisted candidates may be required to complete:

* Manage operating budgets, revenue targets, labor costs, and operational expenses for all F&B service points.
* Monitor daily sales, guest covers, average spend per head, and implement proactive upselling initiatives.
* Conduct regular inventory audits for glassware, chinaware, silverware, linens, bar stock, and service equipment.

* Ensure strict adherence to food safety, hygiene (HACCP/ISO standards), and local health department regulations across all service areas and bars.

description:
Core Roles & Responsibilities

* **Site Supervision & Execution:** Oversee daily construction activities for civil and structural works, including roads, buildings, foundations, and enabling infrastructure. They ensure all work aligns with approved engineering drawings, blueprints, and project plans. [1, 2]
* **Quality Assurance & Control:** Conduct regular inspections of workmanship, materials, and structural alignments. This includes performing precise level, line, and thickness measurements, as well as checking reinforcement detailing (bar diameter, spacing, formwork stability) before pouring concrete.
* **Safety & Regulatory Compliance:** Enforce strict on-site safety protocols, hazard assessments, and health regulations. They verify that all workers wear necessary personal protective equipment (PPE) and comply with regulatory building codes.
* **Workforce & Subcontractor Coordination:** Supervise, motivate, and direct site labourers, trade partners, and subcontractors. They allocate daily tasks, manage worker attendance, and maintain a productive site environment.
* **Resource & Logistics Management:** Monitor the deployment and safe utilization of heavy construction machinery, tools, and utilities. They track building material inventories, coordinate deliveries, and manage material requisitions to minimize waste and delay.
* **Progress Tracking & Reporting:** Document daily site progress, prepare look-ahead schedules, and log cost metrics. They regularly report progress, variations, and bottlenecks to the Project Manager.
* **Problem-Solving & Conflict Resolution:** Identify structural flaws, design mismatches, or logistical roadblocks early, implementing field corrections or escalating major issues to engineers and clients through collaborative discussion.

Key Requirements & Qualifications

* **Education:** A **Diploma or Bachelor's degree in Civil Engineering**, Construction Management, or a closely related technical field is widely preferred.
* **Experience:** Typically requires **3 to 5+ years of practical experience** in civil construction, with a proven track record in a supervisory or leading-hand capacity.
* **Technical Skills:** Proficiency in reading complex blueprint drawings and technical documents. Familiarity with software like **AutoCAD** for drawing verification and a strong understanding of concrete mix types, soil testing, and construction codes.

title: Operation Executive
description:
1. Job Purpose

The Operation Executive is responsible for coordinating and supporting day-to-day air

ambulance and medical evacuation operations, ensuring the safe, timely, and eHicient

execution of missions. The role involves flight planning coordination, obtaining flight

permits and clearances, coordinating with aircraft operators, hospitals, medical teams,

ground ambulance providers, handling agents, and other relevant stakeholders to

ensure seamless mission execution.

2. Key Responsibilities

A. Flight Operations and Mission Coordination

* Coordinate domestic and international air ambulance and medical evacuation

missions.

* Share the Quotes with the sales team.

* Monitor flight schedules, aircraft availability, estimated departure and arrival

times, and mission progress.

* Coordinate with aircraft operators, flight crews, dispatch teams, and other

operational stakeholders.

* Arrange aircraft positioning, technical fuel stops, crew requirements, and

ground support services as required.

* Ensure timely communication and updates to clients, management, and

relevant stakeholders throughout the mission.

* Monitor operational developments and promptly escalate delays, disruptions, or

other critical issues to the Operation Manager.

B. Ground Handling Coordination

* Coordinate ground handling arrangements for domestic and international air

ambulance, medical evacuation, VIP charter, and business aviation flights.

* Obtain handling quotations from FBOs, ground handlers, and local service

providers.

Arrange aircraft arrival and departure handling, parking, passenger assistance,

crew services, and other airport-related requirements.

* Coordinate with handling agents regarding landing permits, slots, parking

approvals, CIQ (Customs, Immigration, and Quarantine), and other applicable

airport requirements.

* Arrange crew transportation, hotel accommodation, catering, and other ground

support services as requested.

* Coordinate with aircraft operators and flight crews to confirm handling

requirements and operational schedules.

* Monitor flight movements and communicate schedule changes, delays, or

cancellations to the relevant service providers.

* Ensure that handling arrangements are confirmed in advance and that the

required services are available at the designated airports.

* Resolve handling-related issues promptly and escalate operational concerns to

the Operation Manager.

C. Flight Permits and Regulatory Compliance

§ Coordinate and obtain overflight, landing, departure, parking, and other

necessary flight permits and clearances.

§ Liaise with Civil Aviation Authorities (CAAs), airport authorities, ground handlers,

and local aviation representatives.

§ Assist with obtaining landing slots, airport permissions, diplomatic clearances,

and other operational approvals.

§ Verify aircraft, crew, passenger, and medical team documentation required for

mission execution.

§ Maintain accurate records of permits, approvals, clearances, and operational

correspondence.

§ Ensure compliance with applicable aviation regulations, company procedures,

and country-specific operational requirements.

D. Medical Evacuation Coordination

o Coordinate with Sales Team, Case Managers and Medical Team.

o Arrange ground ambulance Tarmac Access.

o Coordinate medical team positioning, patient transfer schedules, and required

medical equipment arrangements.

o Handle sensitive medical and passenger information confidentially and

professionally.o Ensure that all stakeholders receive timely updates regarding patient transfer

arrangements and mission progress.

E. Aircraft Operator and Vendor Coordination

* Liaise with aircraft operators, charter providers, handling agents, fuel suppliers,

and other aviation service providers.

* Obtain and compare aircraft availability, quotations, operating details, and

estimated flight times.

* Arrange and Coordinate ground handling, refuelling, catering, crew

accommodation, transportation, and other support services.

* Follow up with vendors to ensure timely confirmation of services and

operational arrangements.

* Maintain updated records of vendor contacts, service providers, rates, and

operational requirements.

F. Flight Planning and Documentation

§ Assist in preparing operational itineraries, flight schedules, routing details, and

mission plans.

§ Coordinate route planning, estimated flying times, fuel requirements, technical

stops, and airport feasibility with the relevant operator or flight crew.

§ Collect and verify operational documents, including aircraft registration,

airworthiness documents, insurance, crew licences, and other required

paperwork, as applicable.

§ Prepare and maintain mission files, operational checklists, flight status reports,

and post-mission documentation.

§ Ensure that all relevant documents and approvals are available before mission

commencement.

G. Aviation Fuel Coordination

* Coordinate aviation fuel requirements for air ambulance, business aviation,

charter, and other aircraft operations.

* Obtain competitive fuel quotations from international and domestic fuel

suppliers.

* Arrange and confirm fuel availability at designated airports and FBOs.

* Coordinate fuel orders, releases, and uplift confirmations with suppliers,

operators, and handling agents.

* Verify fuel grades, quantities, airport details, pricing, applicable taxes, and other

charges before confirming orders.

* Monitor fuel delivery and uplift status and resolve discrepancies or operational

issues promptly.

Ensure timely fuel arrangements for urgent medical evacuation missions and

other time-critical flights.

H. Client Communication and Service Delivery

o Maintain professional communication with clients, brokers, hospitals, and

partner organizations.

o Provide timely updates on aircraft availability, permit status, flight schedules,

and operational progress.

o Support the preparation and follow-up of operational quotations and service

confirmations.

o Respond promptly to client enquiries and coordinate with the relevant

departments to resolve operational concerns.

o Maintain a high standard of customer service, confidentiality, and

professionalism.

I. Customer Invoicing

§ Prepare accurate customer invoices for ground handling, airport charges,

permits, fuel coordination, transportation, accommodation, and other services

provided by the company, as applicable.

§ Verify customer invoices against approved quotations, confirmed orders, actual

services rendered, and applicable commercial terms.

§ Ensure that invoices include the correct customer details, flight information,

aircraft registration, service descriptions, currency, taxes, and payment terms.

§ Raise invoices promptly after completion of the service or in accordance with

the agreed billing schedule.

§ Coordinate with the Accounts Department for invoice approval, issuance, and

submission to customers.

§ Send invoices and supporting documents to customers and follow up on invoice

acknowledgement where required.

§ Prepare revised invoices or credit notes only after obtaining the necessary

approval.

§ Maintain proper records of invoices issued, pending billing, and customer billing

queries.

J. Supplier Invoice Verification and Cost Control

* Collect invoices from handling agents, FBOs, airport authorities, and other

service providers.

* Cross-check supplier invoices against the original quotations, purchase orders,

service confirmations, and agreed rates.

* Verify actual charges, taxes, surcharges, parking duration, additional services,

and any supplementary fees.• Identify discrepancies, duplicate charges, incorrect rates, or unsupported

expenses and seek clarification from the relevant vendor.

* Coordinate with suppliers to obtain corrected invoices or credit notes where

necessary.

* Ensure that supplier invoices are submitted to the Accounts Department within

the required timelines.

* Maintain accurate records of mission-wise operational costs and supporting

documentation.

* Assist in monitoring costs against quoted amounts and identifying variations that

may aHect profitability.

K. Accounts Receivable and Payable Coordination

o Maintain an updated tracker of customer invoices, supplier invoices, due dates,

and payment status.

o Coordinate with the Accounts Department regarding customer collections and

supplier payments.

o Follow up on overdue customer invoices and communicate payment updates to

management.

o Monitor supplier payment deadlines and highlight urgent payments that could

aHect operational continuity.

o Assist in reconciling customer accounts, supplier statements, and mission-

related transactions.

o Maintain supporting documents for payment processing, including quotations,

invoices, receipts, and service confirmations.

o Escalate disputed invoices, overdue receivables, and potential credit issues to

the Operation Manager and Accounts Department.

L. Pricing and Profitability Management

§ Obtain and compare fuel prices from multiple suppliers to identify the most

commercially attractive options.

§ Calculate selling prices by considering supplier costs, taxes, transaction fees,

currency conversion, payment terms, and applicable service charges.

§ Ensure that quotations meet the company's approved pricing and margin

requirements.

§ Monitor gross profit and profitability for individual fuel transactions and

customer accounts.

§ Identify opportunities to increase margins through supplier negotiations,

reduced fees, improved credit terms, and increased sales volume.

§ Escalate exceptional pricing requests or transactions below approved margins

for management approval

M. Reporting and Administrative Support

* Prepare daily operational updates, mission summaries, and weekly activity

reports.

* Maintain accurate records of missions, quotations, permits, flight hours,

operational expenses, and vendor invoices.

* Assist with cost tracking, invoice verification, and coordination with the

Accounts Department.

* Support the Operation Manager in preparing operational performance reports

and identifying opportunities for improvement.

* Perform other operational duties assigned by the Operation Manager or

management.

* Prepare database for Handling & Fueling with Supplier details along with their

Charges.

3. Qualifications and Experience

§ Bachelor's degree or diploma in Aviation Management, Airport Management,

Logistics, Business Administration, or a related field.

§ Previous experience in aviation operations, air ambulance services, flight

dispatch, charter operations, or travel coordination will be an advantage.

§ Knowledge of domestic and international flight operations, aviation

documentation, and flight permit procedures is preferred.

§ Familiarity with aircraft operators, handling agents, ground ambulance

providers, and aviation service vendors is desirable.

§ Freshers with relevant qualifications and a strong interest in aviation operations

may also be considered.

4. Required Skills and Competencies

o Good written and verbal communication skills in English.

o Strong coordination, planning, and organizational abilities.

o Ability to work under pressure and manage multiple missions simultaneously.

o Good attention to detail and accuracy in documentation.

o Strong problem-solving and follow-up skills.

o Proficiency in Microsoft OHice, email, spreadsheets, and online operational

systems.

o Ability to work flexible hours, including weekends, public holidays, and after-

hours shifts, depending on operational requirements.

o Ability to handle confidential patient and client information responsibly.

o A proactive, customer-focused, and team-oriented approach.5. Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)

Performance will be assessed based on the following:

* Mission Coordination: Timely and accurate coordination of assigned missions.

* Permit Management: Timely submission, follow-up, and tracking of required

flight permits and clearances.

* Operational Accuracy: Accuracy of flight schedules, documentation,

itineraries, and mission records.

* Communication: Timely and eHective updates to clients, operators,

management, and other stakeholders.

* Response Time: Prompt handling of operational requests and urgent mission

requirements.

* Vendor Coordination: EHective follow-up with aircraft operators, handling

agents, medical teams, and other service providers.

* Reporting: Timely submission of accurate operational reports and maintenance

of mission files.

* Quotation Conversion Rate: Percentage of fuel quotations converted into

confirmed orders.

* Fuel Cost Competitiveness: Ability to obtain competitive supplier rates and

favourable commercial terms.

* Operational EXiciency: Timely and accurate fuel order confirmation and uplift

coordination.

* Compliance: Adherence to company procedures, confidentiality requirements,

and applicable operational regulations.

* Customer Satisfaction: Professional service delivery and eHective resolution or

escalation of operational issues.

* Teamwork: EHective coordination with colleagues and support for overall

departmental objectives.

6. Working Conditions

§ The position involves coordination of time-sensitive domestic and international

aviation operations.

§ Flexible working hours may be required depending on mission schedules, time

zones, and emergency medical evacuation requirements.

§ The employee may be required to remain reachable during assigned operational

shifts and provide handover information to ensure continuity.

§ The role requires frequent communication with stakeholders across diHerent

countries and time zones.

7. Authority and Reporting

The Operation Executive reports directly to the Operation Manager and is responsible

for executing assigned operational tasks in accordance with established company

procedures.

The employee must promptly escalate safety concerns, regulatory issues, permit

delays, major schedule changes, and other critical operational matters to the

Operation Manager. Any operational commitments or decisions beyond the employee's

delegated authority must be approved by the appropriate manager.

8. Overall Objective

To support the safe, eHicient, timely, and cost-eHective execution of air ambulance and

medical evacuation missions through eHective operational coordination, regulatory

documentation, stakeholder communication, and proactive problem-solving, while

maintaining the highest standards of service and confidentiality.

* Coordinate with the production and stores departments.

title: Senior Accounts Executive
description:
**Job Summary**

We are looking for an experienced **Accounts Executive with strong hands-on experience in end-to-end accounting**, including general accounting, GST compliance and filing, TDS, and financial record management. The ideal candidate should have a thorough understanding of accounting principles, strong practical knowledge of **Tally ERP/Tally Prime**, and the ability to independently manage day-to-day accounting operations from transaction recording to reconciliations, statutory compliance, and financial reporting.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Handle **end-to-end accounting activities**, including recording and maintaining all financial transactions, journal entries, sales, purchases, receipts, and payments.
* Maintain accurate books of accounts, general ledgers, cash books, bank books, and other accounting records.
* Manage day-to-day accounting operations independently using **Tally ERP/Tally Prime**.
* Handle GST-related activities, including GST data preparation, reconciliation, return preparation, and **GST return filing**.
* Manage TDS-related activities, including calculation, deduction, payment coordination, reconciliation, and **TDS return filing**.
* Perform bank, vendor, customer, and inter-account reconciliations and resolve discrepancies.
* Manage accounts payable and accounts receivable, including invoice verification, payment tracking, and outstanding follow-ups.
* Verify invoices, vouchers, expense claims, and supporting documents to ensure accuracy and compliance.
* Conduct ledger scrutiny and ensure proper classification and recording of financial transactions.
* Prepare monthly financial reports, account statements, and other financial summaries as required.
* Assist with month-end and year-end closing activities and ensure timely completion of accounting records.
* Maintain proper documentation for GST, TDS, audits, and other statutory requirements.
* Coordinate with vendors, customers, internal departments, and external auditors on accounting and finance-related matters.
* Support statutory audits by preparing schedules, reconciliations, and relevant financial documents.
* Ensure compliance with applicable accounting standards, taxation regulations, and statutory deadlines.
* Perform other accounting and finance-related duties as assigned by management.

**Required Skills & Qualifications**

* Bachelor's degree in Commerce, Accounting, Finance, or a related field.
* **Minimum 2+ years of hands-on experience in end-to-end accounting.**
* Strong knowledge of general accounting principles and complete bookkeeping processes.
* Practical experience in **GST preparation, reconciliation, and return filing**.
* Good working knowledge of **TDS calculation, deduction, payment, reconciliation, and return filing**.
* **Strong proficiency in Tally ERP/Tally Prime** is essential.
* Experience in bank reconciliation, ledger scrutiny, invoice verification, and financial record maintenance.
* Working knowledge of accounts payable, accounts receivable, and financial reporting.
* Proficiency in MS Excel and other relevant accounting tools.
* Strong analytical skills, numerical accuracy, and attention to detail.
* Ability to independently manage multiple accounting activities and meet statutory deadlines.
* Good communication and coordination skills.

**Preferred Candidate Profile**

* Candidates who have independently handled complete accounting operations, including GST and TDS compliance.
* Professionals with strong practical exposure to Tally and statutory filing procedures.
* Candidates capable of managing accounting activities with minimal supervision and ensuring accurate, timely financial reporting.

* Provident Fund

description:

**Company:** Bestinn Leisure and Hospitality Pvt. Ltd.  
**Department:** Reservations  
**Industry:** Hotel, Leisure & Hospitality  
**Reporting To:** Reservations Manager  
**Employment Type:** Full-Time

1. Job Purpose

The Reservation Executive is responsible for managing hotel and hospitality reservations, handling guest enquiries, processing booking requests, and ensuring a smooth and efficient reservation experience.

The role involves coordinating with hotel properties, front office teams, sales and operations departments to ensure accurate booking management, maximum room occupancy, revenue generation and high levels of guest satisfaction.

2. Key Roles and Responsibilities

**A. Reservation Management**

* Handle incoming reservation enquiries through telephone, email, WhatsApp, online platforms and other communication channels.
* Process individual, group, corporate and travel-agent bookings accurately.
* Check room availability, rates, packages, inclusions and applicable booking policies.
* Create, modify, confirm and cancel reservations in the Property Management System (PMS) or booking software.
* Ensure timely communication of booking confirmations, amendments and cancellation details to guests.
* Maintain accurate reservation records and guest information.

**B. Guest Relationship Management**

* Provide professional, courteous and prompt responses to guest enquiries.
* Explain room categories, hotel facilities, amenities, packages, tariffs and special offers.
* Understand guest requirements and recommend suitable accommodation options.
* Handle guest complaints, special requests and booking-related concerns professionally.
* Ensure a positive guest experience throughout the reservation process.

**C. Sales and Revenue Generation**

* Promote hotel rooms, accommodation packages, holiday packages and additional services.
* Identify upselling and cross-selling opportunities to increase revenue.
* Convert enquiries into confirmed bookings through effective communication and follow-ups.
* Support occupancy targets and revenue objectives.
* Ensure adherence to approved room rates, discounts and promotional offers.

**D. Coordination and Operations**

* Coordinate with Front Office, Housekeeping, Sales, Accounts and Operations teams.
* Communicate confirmed bookings, VIP arrivals, special requests and group requirements to respective properties.
* Follow up with hotels and resorts to ensure room availability and booking confirmations.
* Monitor booking status, payment details, deposits and outstanding balances.
* Ensure smooth coordination for guest arrivals, departures and special arrangements.

**E. Documentation and Reporting**

* Maintain daily reservation reports, booking registers and enquiry records.
* Track confirmed, pending, cancelled and modified reservations.
* Maintain accurate guest profiles and booking documentation.
* Prepare daily, weekly and monthly reservation performance reports.
* Ensure compliance with company reservation procedures and operational policies.

3. Required Skills and Competencies

* Excellent verbal and written communication skills.
* Strong customer service and guest relationship management skills.
* Good telephone etiquette and professional email communication.
* Knowledge of hotel reservation procedures and hospitality operations.
* Basic understanding of room inventory, room tariffs, occupancy and revenue management.
* Familiarity with PMS, CRS, OTA platforms and reservation systems.
* Good knowledge of MS Office, Excel and email applications.
* Strong coordination, negotiation and problem-solving abilities.
* Attention to detail and accuracy in booking management.
* Ability to multitask and work under pressure.
* Positive attitude, professional appearance and a customer-oriented approach.

4. Educational Qualification

* Bachelor's Degree or Diploma in Hotel Management, Hospitality Management, Tourism or Travel Management.
* Candidates with relevant experience in hotel reservations, front office or customer service may also be considered.

5. Experience

* Preferred: 1–3 years of experience in hotel reservations or the hospitality industry.
* Freshers with excellent communication skills and a strong interest in hospitality may also apply.

6. Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)

The performance of the Reservation Executive will be evaluated based on:

* Reservation enquiry response time.
* Enquiry-to-booking conversion ratio.
* Accuracy of reservation entries and booking confirmations.
* Number of confirmed bookings generated.
* Revenue generated through reservations and upselling.
* Guest satisfaction and service quality.
* Follow-up efficiency and enquiry management.
* Compliance with reservation policies and procedures.
* Coordination efficiency with hotel properties and internal departments.
* Timely submission and accuracy of reservation reports.

7. Personal Attributes

* Guest-focused and service-oriented mindset.
* Professional and courteous behaviour.
* Strong sense of responsibility and accountability.
* Good interpersonal and team coordination skills.
* Willingness to learn and adapt to changing business requirements.
* Integrity and confidentiality in handling guest information.
* Flexibility to work in shifts, weekends and holidays as required.

8. Job Accountability

The Reservation Executive is accountable for ensuring efficient reservation handling, accurate booking records, timely guest communication, effective coordination with hotel properties and contributing to the company's overall booking conversion, revenue and guest satisfaction objectives.

**Company:** Bestinn Leisure (Bestinn Hospitality )Pvt. Ltd.

title: Warehouse Manager
description:
***JOB DESCRIPTION: WAREHOUSE MANAGER***

Position Title: Warehouse Manager / Godown In-Charge

Department: Warehouse & Logistics

Employment Type: Full-Time

Location: Warehouse / Godown

Job Purpose

To oversee, direct, and optimize all daily operations of the warehouse/godown. The Warehouse Manager is responsible for inventory integrity, rigorous auditing and reporting schedules, proper material handling and storage, damage prevention, adherence to safety standards, and seamless dispatch logistics.

Key Responsibilities & Core Duties

1. Inventory Management, Audits & Reporting

\* Stock Accuracy: Maintain complete and up-to-date records of all inventory—inward receipts, outward dispatches, transfers, and closing stock.

\* Daily ERP & Register Updates: Ensure daily entry of all physical receipts, issues, and adjustments into the ERP system/inventory registers.

\* Monthly Stock Audit & Reporting: Conduct monthly physical stock counts, reconcile differences against system records, and submit a formal Monthly Stock Audit Report to senior management.

\* Quarterly Comprehensive Audits: Plan, lead, and execute a comprehensive stock audit every three months (quarterly) across all storage sections, rack locations, and product categories.

\* Annual Year-End Stock Closure: Conduct the mandatory Year-End Physical Stock Verification and Reconciliation, generating and handing over the final Annual Stock Valuation & Audit Report to management and accounts.

\* Replenishment & Indenting: Monitor re-order levels, safety stock, and inventory turnover; raise purchase indents proactively to avoid stockouts.

2. Warehouse Operations & Material Handling

\* Receiving & Unloading: Oversee safe unloading, physical verification, count matching against PO/invoices, and quality inspection upon arrival.

\* Storage & Racking: Enforce systematically labeled, location-wise racking and bin storage for quick identification and efficient retrieval (FIFO/proper categorization).

\* Dispatch & Logistics Coordination: Coordinate with the sales and dispatch team to load and dispatch orders strictly according to the delivery schedule.

\* Transport Management: Liaise with transport providers, freight partners, and truck drivers for trip planning, vehicle placement, and timely deliveries.

3. Damage Prevention & Quality Control

\* Damage Inspection: Inspect all incoming consignments and outgoing deliveries for transit defects or handling damages.

\* Damage Documentation: Maintain an accurate and updated Damage & Rejection Register; report defective materials immediately to purchase/management.

\* Preventive Handling: Implement best practices in material handling, palletization, and stacking to eliminate product breakage and wastage.

4. Documentation & Statutory Compliance

\* Registers & Records: Systematically maintain all warehouse documentation, including Goods Receipt Notes (GRN), Inward/Outward Registers, Delivery Challans, Gate Passes, and Lorry Receipts (LR copies).

\* Filing & Traceability: Ensure that all signed delivery acknowledgments, customer challans, and transporter documents are verified, filed, and accessible for audits.

5. Team Leadership, Safety & Housekeeping

\* Workforce Supervision: Supervise warehouse supervisors, loading labor, and helpers; allocate daily tasks and ensure operational productivity.

\* Housekeeping & Cleanliness: Ensure 100% cleanliness, proper aisle clearance, and orderly housekeeping across the warehouse facility.

\* Health & Safety Compliance: Enforce standard safety protocols, fire safety readiness, material handling norms, and mandatory use of Personal Protective Equipment (PPE).

6. Inter-Departmental Coordination

\* Collaborate closely with Sales, Purchase, Accounts, and Logistics departments to resolve discrepancies, clarify order priorities, and maintain smooth workflows.

\* Keep executive management informed of space constraints, aging/slow-moving inventory, stock discrepancies, or operational bottlenecks.

Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)

\* Inventory Accuracy: \ge 99\% alignment between physical stock and ERP records.

\* Audit Adherence: 100% on-time submission of monthly, quarterly, and year-end stock audit reports.

\* Dispatch Timeliness: On-time, error-free order fulfillment against scheduled dispatches.

\* Shrinkage & Damage Rate: Zero unrecorded shrinkage and minimal handling damage.

\* Safety & Housekeeping: Clean, incident-free warehouse premises adhering to safety norms.

title: Sales Officer
description:
JOB DESCRIPTION (JD)Sales Officer – Viya Builders Pvt. Ltd.

**Department:** Sales & Business Development  
**Designation:** Sales Officer  
**Reporting To:** Sales Manager / Business Development Manager  
**Location:** Office and project locations, as required  
**Employment Type:** Full-time  
**Grade:** Proposed G2–G3, subject to Viya's salary architecture  
**Document Owner:** HR Department

1. Job Purpose

The Sales Officer is responsible for generating qualified customer leads, developing business opportunities, presenting Viya Builders' construction services, coordinating customer meetings, following up on prospects, and converting potential customers into confirmed projects.

The role requires a systematic, customer-focused, and target-oriented approach to support the company's revenue growth and business development objectives.

2. Key Responsibilities

**A. Lead Generation and Business Development**

* Generate leads through referrals, networking, digital channels, field visits, and other approved sources.
* Identify potential customers planning to construct residential or commercial buildings.
* Develop relationships with prospective customers, architects, consultants, landowners, and other relevant business contacts.
* Maintain a consistent pipeline of qualified sales opportunities.
* Follow up on marketing-generated leads within the company's prescribed response time.

**B. Customer Handling and Sales Conversion**

* Understand customer requirements, budget, project location, construction expectations, and timelines.
* Explain Viya Builders' services, project execution process, quality standards, and commercial terms.
* Arrange customer meetings, site visits, and discussions with the relevant technical or management teams.
* Coordinate preparation and presentation of quotations and proposals with the concerned departments.
* Follow up on proposals, address customer queries, and support negotiations within approved commercial limits.
* Work towards converting qualified leads into confirmed construction projects.

**C. Sales Pipeline and CRM Management**

* Record all leads, calls, meetings, follow-ups, quotations, and sales outcomes in the designated CRM or tracking system.
* Maintain accurate customer contact details and project requirements.
* Update the status of every active opportunity regularly.
* Prepare daily activity reports and weekly sales pipeline reports.
* Ensure no qualified lead is neglected due to delayed follow-up.

**D. Customer Coordination and Internal Communication**

* Coordinate with the technical, estimation, design, commercial, and project teams to respond to customer requirements.
* Communicate customer commitments accurately and avoid making unauthorized promises regarding price, specifications, or project completion dates.
* Ensure proper handover of confirmed projects to the concerned internal team.
* Support customer communication during the pre-contract and sales handover stages.
* Escalate customer concerns, commercial disputes, and potential business risks to the reporting manager.

**E. Sales Target Achievement**

* Work towards monthly and quarterly lead-generation, meeting, proposal, and project-conversion targets.
* Monitor conversion rates and identify reasons for lost opportunities.
* Develop follow-up plans for pending proposals and high-potential customers.
* Support sales campaigns, customer outreach activities, and promotional initiatives.
* Contribute to the department's revenue and business development objectives.

3. Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)

The following KPIs should be finalized by the Sales Manager based on the company's sales strategy and available lead volume.

KPIMeasurementLead generationNumber of qualified leads generatedLead responsePercentage of leads contacted within the prescribed response timeCustomer meetingsNumber of qualified customer meetings completedFollow-up compliancePercentage of scheduled follow-ups completed on timeProposal conversionPercentage of submitted proposals converted into confirmed projectsSales achievementConfirmed sales value against the assigned targetCRM complianceCompleteness and accuracy of sales recordsPipeline managementValue and quality of active sales opportunitiesCustomer experienceCustomer feedback and complaints attributable to sales handlingHandover complianceCompleteness of documentation transferred after confirmation

**Important:** Targets must be measurable, realistic, and approved before the performance period begins. Sales value, conversion rate, and activity targets should be assessed together rather than relying on call volume alone.

4. Qualification and Experience

**Educational Qualification**

* Bachelor's degree or diploma in Business Administration, Marketing, Commerce, or a related field.
* Candidates with relevant construction-industry sales experience may also be considered.

**Experience**

* Preferably 1–3 years of experience in sales, business development, real estate, building materials, construction services, or a related industry.
* Freshers with strong communication skills and a willingness to learn may be considered for junior-level positions.

5. Required Skills and Competencies

* Strong verbal and written communication.
* Customer relationship management and negotiation.
* Lead generation and sales follow-up.
* Basic commercial understanding and quotation coordination.
* Ability to understand construction-service offerings.
* CRM, spreadsheet, email, and reporting skills.
* Time management and systematic work habits.
* Professional customer handling and problem-solving.
* Ability to work towards measurable targets.
* Integrity, accountability, and coordination across departments.

6. Authority and Limitations

The Sales Officer may:

* Contact prospective customers and arrange meetings.
* Explain approved company services and pricing.
* Coordinate quotations and proposals.
* Conduct authorized customer visits.
* Recommend commercial solutions to the reporting manager.

The Sales Officer may not independently:

* Approve discounts or change approved pricing.
* Commit to unapproved project specifications or delivery dates.
* Sign contracts or agree to non-standard commercial terms without authorization.
* Make commitments on behalf of technical, project execution, or finance teams without confirmation.

7. Reporting and Review Mechanism

* **Daily:** Lead updates, customer interactions, planned follow-ups, and immediate escalations.
* **Weekly:** Sales pipeline review, meeting outcomes, proposal status, and expected conversions.
* **Monthly:** KPI performance, target achievement, lost-lead analysis, and next-month sales plan.
* **Quarterly:** Performance review, competency development, and target realignment where required.

All reporting must be submitted through the company's approved CRM, sales tracker, or reporting format.

8. Performance Expectations

The Sales Officer is expected to demonstrate ownership of assigned leads, timely follow-up, accurate reporting, professional customer handling, ethical sales practices, and measurable contribution to business growth.

Performance will be evaluated based on results, process compliance, customer experience, teamwork, and individual accountability.

9. Career Progression

Subject to sustained performance, demonstrated competencies, business requirements, and management approval, the potential career path is:

The ideal candidate should have hands-on experience in freight forwarding operations, rate procurement, pricing, shipment coordination, and customer service for air and ocean freight.

* Maintain proper filing of invoices, receipts, vouchers, bank statements, and tax records.
* Provide accurate financial information to management whenever required.
* Support budgeting, expense monitoring, and financial analysis.

* Assist in internal and external audits by providing required financial records and supporting documents.
* Ensure compliance with company accounting procedures and financial policies.
* Identify accounting discrepancies and report them to the Finance Manager.
* Maintain confidentiality and integrity of all financial information.

Job Overview

Central Hardwares is looking for an experienced Finance, Accounts & MIS Manager to manage and develop the central finance function across our multiple showrooms, godowns and business entities.

The candidate will be responsible for consolidating accounts, analysing business performance, monitoring inventory and working capital, preparing management reports, and implementing strong financial controls and standard operating procedures.

We are looking for a hands-on finance professional who can establish systems, improve financial transparency and support the company’s expansion.

Key Responsibilities

* Consolidate accounting records and financial statements across all locations and business entities.
* Manage monthly financial closing, bank reconciliation, cash reconciliation, UPI reconciliation and stock reconciliation.
* Analyse sales, purchases, expenses, profitability and margins by product, brand, customer and location.
* Monitor inventory valuation, stock ageing, stock movement and physical stock verification.
* Track customer outstanding balances, receivables ageing, supplier payables and cash flow.
* Prepare daily sales and collection reports, weekly performance reports and monthly MIS reports.
* Develop location-wise profit and loss statements, budgets and budget-versus-actual reports.
* Coordinate with the Credit Control Executive to monitor outstanding payments and improve collection visibility.
* Coordinate with external Chartered Accountants and auditors for GST, TDS, income tax and statutory compliance.
* Standardise accounting practices, reporting formats, financial policies and SOPs across locations.
* Guide accounts and billing staff and improve the accuracy and timeliness of financial reporting.
* Recommend improvements to accounting software, internal controls and financial processes.
* Provide management with financial analysis and recommendations for pricing, purchasing, cost control and business expansion.

Required Qualifications

* B.Com or M.Com is mandatory.
* MBA Finance, CMA, CA Inter or CA qualification is preferred.
* 7–10 years of experience in accounting and finance.
* At least 3 years of experience in multi-location accounting, financial consolidation, MIS or finance controllership.
* Experience in trading, distribution, retail or building materials is preferred.

Required Skills

* Strong knowledge of accounting software such as Tally Prime, Zoho or similar systems.
* Advanced Microsoft Excel skills, including Pivot Tables, lookup functions and dashboards.
* Knowledge of Power BI or other reporting tools is an advantage.
* Good understanding of inventory accounting, stock ageing, margin analysis and working capital.
* Working knowledge of GST, TDS and income tax compliance.
* Strong analytical, problem-solving and financial reporting skills.
* Ability to build systems and processes from the ground up.
* High integrity, accuracy and discretion when handling financial information.
* Good communication skills and the ability to coordinate with multiple departments.
* Fluency in Malayalam and English.

Additional Requirements

* Must be based in or willing to relocate near Erattupetta, Kerala.
* Willingness to travel between showrooms and godowns, including the Vagamon location.
* Ability to work directly with management and coordinate with sales, purchase, accounts, billing, stores and credit control teams.

What We Are Looking For

We are looking for a finance professional who can go beyond routine accounting and take ownership of consolidated financial reporting, business analysis, inventory visibility and financial controls across multiple locations.

The successful candidate will help establish a reliable central finance function that supports better decision-making and the future growth of Central Hardwares.

description:
**Location:** Thiruvamkulam,Kalmassery.

**Job Type:** Full-time

**Department:** Sales

**Reporting To:** Sales Manager / Branch Head

**Job Purpose**

The Showroom Sales Executive is responsible for driving sales of Honda two-wheelers (scooters and motorcycles) by delivering an engaging, informative, and customer-focused sales experience. This role involves guiding walk-in customers through the product lineup, explaining features and financing options, conducting test rides, and driving the purchase process from initial inquiry to vehicle delivery.

**Key Responsibilities**

**1. Customer Engagement & Consultation**

* Greet walk-in customers warmly and understand their vehicle preferences, usage requirements, and budget.
* Present and demonstrate Honda two-wheeler models, highlighting key features, technologies (e.g., eSP, PGM-Fi, H-Smart), specifications, and color variants.
* Arrange and accompany customers on test rides, ensuring safety guidelines and necessary documentation (driving license verification) are followed.

**2. Sales Conversion & Financial Pitching**

* Explain pricing structures, discounts/offers, vehicle insurance packages, extended warranty options, and accessories.
* Pitch and coordinate auto loan/finance schemes by working closely with in-house finance executives and banking partners to assist customers with down payments and EMI calculations.
* Convert walk-in leads and phone inquiries into firm bookings and sales.

**3. Lead Management & Follow-up**

* Capture accurate customer details in the CRM software / Sales Register.
* Follow up systematically with potential leads, test-ride prospects, and open inquiries via calls or messaging.
* Conduct post-delivery follow-ups to ensure customer satisfaction and encourage referrals.

* Ensure all sales documentation (RTO registration forms, invoicing, insurance, finance approval) is completed accurately and promptly.
* Coordinate vehicle preparation, polishing, and accessory fitting with the pre-delivery inspection (PDI) team.
* Conduct a smooth and memorable vehicle handover ceremony for the customer, explaining key features and warranty/service schedules during delivery.

**5. Showroom Standards & Market Intelligence**

* Keep the display vehicles clean, well-arranged, and stocked with updated specification brochures and promotional materials.
* Stay updated on competitor models, local market trends, and Honda’s official sales campaigns and schemes.

**Key Requirements & Qualifications**

* **Education:** Higher Secondary (12th Pass) or Graduation in any discipline.

* Strong persuasive, negotiation, and closing skills.
* Customer-first mindset with high enthusiasm and active listening skills.
* Target-driven approach with a focus on achieving monthly vehicle sales and accessory targets.
* Professional appearance and good interpersonal skills.

* **Negotiation:** Negotiate rates with carriers and other service providers.

**Primary Responsibilities and Duties:**

* Provide support in all pricing activities related to; customer requests for quotation, pricing proposals, and costing system analysis ensuring profitability.

* Works to develop, plan and recommend pricing actions that drive additional profit for the company through product, customer or regional pricing.

* Maintains an expert-level knowledge of all company’s pricing methodologies, external market forces, and internal factors which influence pricing.

* Analyze pricing inputs such as vendor costs, operational costs and/or actuals to determine appropriate pricing based on pricing guidelines and internal/external factors.

* Communicate with internal departments and outside vendors to resolve issues concerning cost.

* Analyze products and establish total cost and adjust pricing as appropriate to ensure margins are maintained.

* Provide expert-level guidance in resolving complex pricing tasks.

* Maintain customer pricing database and communicate customer pricing changes to sales.

* Analyze and report on product cost at all locations to assure consistent and accurate pricing.

* Responsible for working with other company functions to learn and gain expert knowledge on the product offerings.

* Assists in the development of pricing strategy with the pricing and finance teams. Recommends and enforces pricing policies and strategies to maintain or improve competitive position and/or profitability.

* Perform detailed analysis of product and competitive data to optimize regular prices for merchandising categories. Track and measure margin performance (sales, margin, cost, freight, equipment, etc.)

* Develops strategic recommendations by working with business units to analyze and understand all necessary data, including internal sales data, market trends, competitive landscape and current prices.

* Populates pricing requests with proper rates, accessorial, and delivery costs.

* Coordinates with sales, and customer service to ensure timely quoting and follow up on pricing requests.

* Takes initiative in identifying and resolving issues around pricing.

* Have a thorough knowledge of the product line, sales process, delivery capabilities, and operational methods.

* Evaluate and maintain market price integrity while understanding the competitive environment.

* Understands business implications of decisions and displays orientation to profitability.

* Demonstrates knowledge of market and competition; Aligns pricing with strategic goals.

**Communication Skills:**

* Must have strong interpersonal, oral, and written communication skills. Be able to communicate on all levels within an organization.

* Responsive to the needs of internal and external customers with sense of urgency and commitment to follow up.

* Ability to effectively present information and respond to questions from internal and external customers.

**Knowledge, Skills, and Abilities:**

* Have strong computer skills and be proficient in MS Word, specifically Excel. Advanced excel skills would be an advantage.

* Willingness to learn and work closely with others to understand the organization.

* Ability to work flexible hours in order to meet deadlines and to manage tight timelines as required.

* Must have strong mathematical and analytical skills.

* Must have the strong ability to multi-task.

* Must have a strong work ethic and drive to achieve established goals and deadlines, with a desire for, and commitment to learning and growth

* Must be organized, efficient, detail oriented, accurate. ability to prioritize and work under pressure and meet deadlines with minimum supervision.

* Must be able to make independent fact-based decisions in a quick and responsive manner.
