title: Senior Manager – Business Growth & Strategic Partnerships
description:
Senior Manager – Business Growth & Strategic Partnerships

Company: Datameris IT Solutions Pvt. Ltd.

Location: Kerala, India

Employment Type: Full-Time

Department: Business Growth & Strategy

Reporting To: Chief Executive Officer

Compensation: Competitive Fixed Salary + Performance-Linked Revenue Incentives

About Datameris

Datameris is a technology-driven organization focused on building innovative businesses and delivering meaningful solutions across technology, education, and healthcare.

Our business portfolio includes:

* Datameris IT Solutions: Technology consulting, software engineering, digital transformation, and our strategic expansion into AI transformation consulting.

* Datameris Launchpad: Industry-integrated education, professional development, and workforce transformation.

* Cure & Wellness: A technology-enabled healthcare and wellness platform connecting individuals with curated treatment and wellness experiences.

As we expand our businesses, markets, and strategic capabilities, we are strengthening our commercial leadership to accelerate revenue growth, develop high-value partnerships, and create sustainable business opportunities.

The Opportunity

We are seeking an accomplished and commercially driven Senior Manager – Business Growth & Strategic Partnerships to lead strategic business development initiatives and contribute directly to revenue growth across our business portfolio.

This is a high-impact leadership position requiring a strong combination of commercial acumen, strategic thinking, relationship development, negotiation capabilities, and execution excellence.

The successful candidate will work closely with the CEO and cross-functional leadership teams to identify growth opportunities, develop new revenue channels, establish strategic alliances, and convert commercial initiatives into measurable business outcomes.

The role offers significant ownership, exposure to diverse industries and business models, and the opportunity to contribute to the organization's long-term growth strategy.

Key Responsibilities

Revenue Growth & Business Development

* Develop and execute revenue growth strategies across multiple business verticals, aligned with organizational objectives.

* Identify, qualify, develop, and convert high-value business opportunities into sustainable revenue.

* Build and manage a structured sales and business development pipeline with clearly defined revenue targets and conversion milestones.

* Drive new customer acquisition, enterprise business development, channel expansion, and commercial partnerships.

* Take direct accountability for assigned revenue targets, pipeline development, deal closures, and revenue realization.

* Evaluate new business models, market opportunities, and revenue streams to support portfolio-wide growth.

Strategic Partnerships & Alliances

* Establish and manage commercially valuable relationships with educational institutions, universities, corporate organizations, healthcare providers, wellness resorts, and other relevant industry partners.

* Identify and develop strategic alliances that strengthen market access, distribution capabilities, and revenue potential.

* Lead partnership discussions, commercial negotiations, proposal development, and agreement finalization.

* Develop institutional partnerships, corporate learning collaborations, employer networks, referral programs, and channel partnerships.

* Establish measurable commercial objectives for partnerships and ensure their successful activation and ongoing performance.

* Represent the organization in strategic business meetings, industry forums, institutional engagements, and partnership discussions.

Growth Strategy & Market Expansion

* Collaborate with business and marketing leaders to develop effective go-to-market strategies.

* Identify opportunities for market penetration, geographical expansion, service diversification, and strategic positioning.

* Conduct market research, competitive analysis, and commercial feasibility assessments.

* Develop scalable customer acquisition and partnership-led growth models.

* Identify emerging opportunities in AI transformation consulting, workforce development, and technology-enabled healthcare services.

* Recommend commercially viable growth initiatives supported by clear business cases, investment requirements, and projected returns.

Commercial Leadership & Cross-Functional Collaboration

* Work closely with project managers, sales leaders, marketing managers, and operational teams to align growth initiatives with revenue objectives.

* Coordinate commercial priorities, lead qualification standards, sales pipeline development, and conversion improvement initiatives.

* Support business leaders in strengthening revenue forecasting, sales effectiveness, and partnership performance.

* Identify commercial bottlenecks and develop actionable solutions to improve business outcomes.

* Provide strategic recommendations to senior management based on market intelligence, performance data, and identified opportunities.

* Foster a commercially accountable, performance-oriented approach to business development.

Revenue Operations & Performance Management

* Establish and maintain accurate CRM pipelines, revenue forecasts, and opportunity tracking mechanisms.

* Define measurable KPIs for business development, strategic partnerships, and assigned revenue initiatives.

* Monitor deal progression, conversion performance, acquisition economics, and realized revenue.

* Provide periodic commercial performance reports, forecasts, and strategic recommendations to the CEO.

* Ensure business development initiatives are commercially viable, adequately qualified, and aligned with organizational profitability expectations.

* Maintain accountability for commercial outcomes, execution timelines, and assigned financial objectives.

Candidate Profile

Qualifications & Experience

* Bachelor's degree in Business Administration, Management, Engineering, Marketing, or a related discipline. An MBA or relevant postgraduate qualification is advantageous.

* Typically 5–10+ years of relevant experience in business development, revenue growth, strategic partnerships, enterprise sales, or commercial management.

* Demonstrated success in achieving revenue targets, acquiring customers, negotiating commercial agreements, and developing profitable business opportunities.

* Experience building institutional, corporate, B2B, or channel partnerships.

* Proven capability in managing complex sales cycles and engaging senior-level decision-makers.

* Strong knowledge of revenue forecasting, sales pipeline management, CRM systems, and commercial performance metrics.

* Experience in technology, SaaS, consulting, EdTech, healthcare, or related growth-oriented industries is desirable.

* Exposure to multiple business verticals, new-market development, or international business development will be an advantage.

Core Competencies

* Commercial acumen and revenue ownership

* Strategic business development

* Partnership development and negotiation

* Enterprise and institutional relationship management

* Go-to-market strategy and market expansion

* Revenue forecasting and pipeline management

* Business analysis and financial judgment

* Stakeholder management and executive communication

* Cross-functional leadership and collaboration

* Independent decision-making and execution accountability

Performance Expectations

The position carries direct accountability for agreed commercial targets and measurable contributions to business growth.

Performance will be evaluated against:

* Achievement of assigned new-business revenue targets.

* Revenue generated through new customer acquisition and strategic partnerships.

* Development and conversion of qualified business opportunities.

* Activation and commercial productivity of institutional, corporate, and channel partnerships.

* Contribution to profitable revenue growth and market expansion.

* Pipeline quality, forecast accuracy, and commercial execution effectiveness.

* Development of sustainable and scalable revenue channels.

Success will be measured primarily through revenue realization, profitable business acquisition, commercially productive partnerships, and sustainable growth outcomes.

Compensation & Performance Rewards

We offer a competitive, performance-oriented compensation structure designed to recognize both professional capability and measurable commercial contribution.

Compensation includes:

* Competitive Fixed Salary: Commensurate with relevant experience, demonstrated capabilities, and the responsibilities of the position.

* Performance-Linked Revenue Incentives: An attractive variable compensation component directly linked to eligible, attributable new-business revenue and achievement of agreed commercial objectives.

* High-Earning Potential: A clearly defined, scalable incentive structure designed to reward exceptional performance, with no arbitrary restriction on earnings from qualifying business, subject to the approved incentive policy.

* Commercial Performance Safeguards: Incentive eligibility and payouts will be governed by documented attribution criteria, realized customer collections, applicable contribution-margin requirements, and adjustments for refunds, cancellations, or reversals.

* Career Progression: Opportunities to advance into broader business growth and commercial leadership responsibilities based on sustained performance, leadership capability, and organizational requirements.

The detailed compensation and incentive framework will be communicated during the selection process.

Why Datameris?

Strategic Business Exposure

Gain direct exposure to multiple growth-oriented businesses across technology, AI, education, and healthcare, with opportunities to work on diverse commercial challenges and emerging markets.

Direct Leadership Engagement

Collaborate closely with the CEO and senior leadership on business strategy, market expansion, partnerships, and major commercial initiatives.

Ownership & Accountability

Take responsibility for meaningful commercial objectives with the autonomy to identify opportunities, develop strategies, and drive execution.

Professional Growth

Be part of an evolving organization with significant opportunities to expand responsibilities and progress into senior commercial leadership roles.

Performance-Driven Rewards

Benefit from a compensation structure that recognizes measurable contribution, revenue generation, and sustained business performance.

Impact & Opportunity

Contribute directly to the growth of multiple businesses while helping establish new revenue channels, strategic relationships, and long-term commercial capabilities.

Our Expectations

We seek professionals who demonstrate a strong sense of ownership, sound commercial judgment, consistent execution, and the ability to deliver measurable results.

The ideal candidate is proactive, commercially ambitious, highly accountable, and comfortable operating in a dynamic environment where initiative and performance are valued.

We are particularly interested in individuals who have demonstrated the ability to build business opportunities, establish meaningful partnerships, and translate commercial strategies into successful outcomes.

Application Process

Interested candidates are invited to submit their updated resume, highlighting relevant experience in revenue generation, strategic partnerships, business development, and commercial leadership.

Shortlisted candidates may be required to present examples of their contributions to business growth, including measurable revenue achievements, successful commercial partnerships, and market expansion initiatives.

**HireFlexGlobal is hiring an experienced and results driven Senior Business Development Executive** to expand our business across Indian and international markets.

We are looking for a confident professional who can connect with business owners, founders, CEOs, and senior decision makers, understand their business challenges, identify opportunities, and build long term client relationships.

**This is more than a traditional sales role.** We need someone who can think independently, understand business problems, recommend suitable solutions, and take ownership of the complete client acquisition process.

The ideal candidate will have strong business judgment, professional communication skills, a problem solving mindset, and a proven record of converting business opportunities into successful client partnerships.

* Develop effective strategies to acquire high-value B2B clients.

* Recommend suitable solutions based on client needs.
* Work with internal teams to prepare proposals and business presentations.
* Manage client objections, commercial discussions, and negotiations professionally.

**3. Strategic Client Acquisition**

* Manage the complete sales cycle, from lead generation to deal closure.
* Build and maintain a qualified pipeline of domestic and international prospects.
* Identify key decision makers and develop strong business relationships.
* Convert potential opportunities into profitable, long-term client partnerships.
* Take responsibility for sales follow ups, negotiations, and client acquisition results.

**4. Client Relationship Management**

* Communicate effectively with stakeholders across different markets and time zones.
* Build client trust through active listening, clear communication, and reliable follow-up.
* Identify opportunities for repeat business and relationship expansion.
* Coordinate with internal teams to support successful client onboarding.

**5. Independent Thinking & Business Ownership**

* Take responsibility for assigned business development activities.
* Make sound business decisions within approved company guidelines.
* Identify market opportunities and recommend growth strategies.
* Maintain accurate sales records, client information, and pipeline reports.
* Demonstrate initiative, accountability, and a results-oriented mindset.

* **Communication:** Strong professional English communication, presentation, and interpersonal skills.

* **Sales Expertise:** Proven experience in lead generation, client acquisition, negotiation, and closing deals.
* **Business Understanding:** Ability to understand complex business challenges and identify practical solutions.
* **Problem-Solving:** Strong analytical thinking, independent judgment, and decision-making skills.
* **Relationship Management:** Ability to build trust and maintain long-term client relationships.
* **Ownership:** A proactive, self driven approach with accountability for business results.
* **Location:** Must be willing to work from our office in **Thrissur, Kerala**.

Preferred Qualifications

* Previous experience acquiring or managing **international B2B clients**.
* Exposure to markets such as the **Middle East, Europe, North America, or other international regions**.
* Experience working directly with founders, CEOs, directors, and senior business executives.
* Proven ability to manage complex sales cycles and high-value business opportunities.
* Familiarity with CRM systems, sales forecasting, and commercial proposals.
* Understanding of international business communication and cross-cultural client relationships.
* Malayalam or Hindi communication skills are an added advantage.

* **Business Acumen:** The ability to understand commercial problems and opportunities.
* **Confidence & Professionalism:** The ability to conduct meaningful discussions with senior decision-makers.
* **Strategic Thinking:** The ability to evaluate opportunities and recommend practical solutions.
* **Ownership & Accountability:** The willingness to take responsibility and deliver results.
* **Emotional Intelligence:** Patience, active listening, empathy, and strong interpersonal judgment.
* **Growth Mindset:** Curiosity, self-motivation, adaptability, and a commitment to improvement.
* **Results Orientation:** A proven ability to build relationships and convert opportunities into business revenue.

What Success Looks Like

A successful candidate will:

* Develop a strong pipeline of domestic and international business opportunities.
* Build trusted relationships with key business decision-makers.
* Understand client challenges and present suitable business solutions.
* Convert qualified leads into successful client partnerships.
* Support long-term client relationships and repeat business.

* Collect and verify customer KYC documents and other required details.
* Upload customer documents and sales details into the designated dealership system.
* Initiate insurance requests and vehicle registration requests as applicable.
* Coordinate retail billing and ensure billing details are accurate.
* Explain insurance, registration, and extended warranty procedures to customers.
* Ensure all documentation is completed as per dealership and statutory requirements.

**E. Customer Follow-up and Coordination**

* Follow up with prospective customers regularly until booking or closure.
* Update lead status and maintain accurate enquiry records in the CRM or designated system.
* Keep customers informed about booking confirmation, billing, registration, insurance, and delivery status.
* Coordinate with the Registration Executive, Insurance Team, Accounts Team, and Delivery Coordinator.
* Escalate delays or customer concerns to the Sales Manager.

**F. Vehicle Delivery and Customer Satisfaction**

* Coordinate with the Delivery Coordinator to ensure timely vehicle delivery.
* Ensure the customer understands the motorcycle's basic features, controls, and maintenance requirements.
* Verify that the necessary documents, accessories, and delivery formalities are completed.
* Maintain a professional delivery experience that meets Honda BigWing standards.
* Collect customer feedback and encourage referrals and repeat business.

**G. Reporting and Target Achievement**

* Submit daily sales activity and follow-up reports to the reporting manager.
* Maintain updated records of enquiries, test rides, bookings, cancellations, and retail sales.
* Participate in sales meetings, product training, and promotional activities.
* Monitor pending leads and take appropriate action to improve conversion rates.

* Basic computer knowledge and familiarity with CRM or dealership software.
* Strong customer-handling, negotiation, and sales-conversion skills.
* Good product presentation and follow-up abilities.
* Target-oriented, self-motivated, and willing to learn.
* Valid two-wheeler driving licence and riding confidence preferred.
* Previous experience in automobile sales or premium motorcycle sales will be an advantage.

* Monthly retail sales achievement.
* Lead-to-booking and booking-to-retail conversion rates.
* Number of customer enquiries handled and test rides conducted.
* Lead follow-up effectiveness and CRM data accuracy.
* Accessories, insurance, and extended warranty performance, where applicable.
* Documentation accuracy and timely completion of billing and registration requests.
* Customer satisfaction, referrals, and repeat business.

5. Expected Professional Standards

* Maintain punctuality, professional grooming, and showroom discipline.
* Follow Honda BigWing customer service standards.
* Provide accurate information and avoid making unauthorized commitments.
* Maintain confidentiality of customer information.
* Work collaboratively with the Sales, Service, Accounts, Insurance, Registration, and Delivery teams.

title: Regional credit control & receivables officer
description:
**JOB PURPOSE**

To manage regional customer credit control, accounts receivable, and collection activities, ensuring timely recovery of outstanding balances, compliance with approved credit terms, and accurate maintenance of customer accounts in SAP Business One (SAP B1).

The role also encompasses customer credit risk monitoring, sales order credit approvals, customer KYC documentation tracking, goods return data maintenance, monthly customer ledger reconciliation, and balance confirmation, in accordance with Company policies, Finance SOPs, Delegation of Authority (DOA), and internal control requirements.

**2. KEY JOB RESPONSIBILITIES**

**2.1 Credit Control & Customer Risk Management**

* Monitor customer outstanding balances, ageing, credit limits, payment terms, and credit utilization to identify overdue accounts and potential credit risks.
* Review customers exceeding approved credit limits or payment terms and coordinate appropriate action with Sales and Head Office Finance.
* Review customer payment history and recommend credit-control measures, including order holds, credit-limit reviews, and escalation of high-risk accounts.
* Ensure credit-limit changes, payment-term deviations, and credit-block releases are processed only with the required authorization.
* Identify doubtful or potentially unrecoverable receivables and escalate them to management for appropriate action.

**2.2 Collection Management & Target Achievement**

* Prepare and monitor weekly and monthly collection plans against assigned targets, tracking actual collections, achievement percentages, and shortfalls.
* Follow up with customers and Sales Executives to secure timely payments and obtain documented payment commitments.
* Prioritize overdue, high-value, and long-outstanding receivables, ensuring timely follow-up until collection or formal resolution.
* Monitor collection shortfalls and broken payment commitments, implement corrective follow-up actions, and escalate significant risks to the Reporting Manager.
* Monitor unapplied and unidentified customer receipts and coordinate their timely allocation against the relevant customer invoices.
* Coordinate with the Finance Team and authorized legal counsel on recovery cases when instructed, maintaining records of legal proceedings, settlements, and recovery status.

**2.3 Customer Ledger Reconciliation & Balance Confirmation**

* Perform monthly reconciliation of customer ledgers in SAP B1 and issue Statements of Account (SOAs) within the prescribed timelines.
* Obtain and maintain customer balance confirmations, follow up on pending confirmations, and document all material differences.
* Investigate discrepancies relating to invoices, receipts, credit notes, goods returns, deductions, and other customer transactions.
* Coordinate with Sales, Logistics, Customer Service, and Finance to resolve discrepancies within agreed timelines and ensure approved adjustments are properly documented.
* Maintain a reconciliation tracker showing confirmation status, outstanding differences, responsible parties, and resolution progress.

**2.4 Customer Goods Returns & Credit Note Coordination**

* Verify customer goods return requests against approved documentation and coordinate with Sales and Logistics to confirm the return status and supporting records.
* Update approved customer goods return data accurately and promptly in SAP B1 or the designated Company system, including customer details, invoice references, item codes, quantities, and return reasons.
* Track pending goods returns and coordinate with Finance for credit note processing following the required verification and approval procedures.
* Identify discrepancies between physical returns, supporting documents, system entries, and credit notes, and follow up until resolution.
* Maintain complete records of goods returns and escalate unsupported, duplicate, or potentially unauthorized transactions.

**2.5 Customer KYC Documentation & Master Data**

* Maintain and regularly update the Customer KYC Register, tracking document receipt, completeness, expiry dates, renewals, and pending submissions.
* Coordinate with customers, Sales, and Head Office Finance to obtain and update required documents, including trade licences, tax registration documents, customer registration forms, and other applicable records.
* Follow up on incomplete, expired, or missing documents and escalate non-compliance in accordance with Company policy.
* Ensure customer onboarding and master data changes are supported by appropriate documentation and approved under the DOA.
* Maintain secure, accurate, and confidential customer documentation.

**2.6 Sales Order Review & Approval**

* Review sales orders in SAP B1 against customer credit limits, outstanding balances, payment terms, account status, and applicable credit-control requirements.
* Identify orders requiring credit review due to overdue balances, credit-limit excesses, account blocks, missing mandatory KYC documents, or deviations from approved terms.
* Approve or release sales orders only within formally delegated authority; refer exceptions and orders exceeding approval limits to the authorized approving authority.
* Maintain records of sales order approvals, held or rejected orders, credit exceptions, and supporting authorizations.
* Coordinate with Sales and Head Office Finance to resolve credit-related order issues without compromising Company credit policy.

**2.7 SAP B1 Administration & Financial Records**

* Maintain accurate customer receivable records in SAP B1, ensuring that customer transactions, receipts, goods returns, and related entries are recorded against appropriate supporting documents.
* Review customer ledger balances, ageing reports, transaction histories, and open items to identify posting errors or discrepancies.
* Ensure customer account adjustments and related transactions are processed only with the required documentation and authorization.
* Coordinate with Head Office Finance to resolve system-related issues and maintain complete, accurate, and traceable financial records.

**2.8 Reporting & Management Information**

* Prepare daily collection follow-up reports, weekly collection performance reports, and monthly receivables and credit-control reports as required by management.
* Report collection targets, actual collections, achievement percentages, shortfalls, overdue ageing, major credit risks, and planned corrective actions.
* Prepare collection forecasts and provide updates on customer payment commitments, high-risk accounts, and legal recovery cases.
* Submit periodic reports on customer balance confirmations, ledger reconciliation differences, pending goods returns, KYC documentation status, and sales order exceptions.
* Ensure all reports are accurate, complete, and submitted within the prescribed timelines through approved communication channels.

**2.9 Compliance & Internal Controls**

* Comply with Company Finance SOPs, Credit Policy, DOA, ERP access controls, and applicable internal control procedures.
* Maintain complete supporting documentation and audit trails for collection activities, customer reconciliations, KYC records, goods returns, and sales order approvals.
* Support internal and external audits by providing accurate records and explanations when required.
* Promptly report suspected fraud, unauthorized transactions, control weaknesses, and significant customer credit risks.
* Maintain confidentiality of Company financial information and customer records and perform other relevant duties assigned by the Reporting Manager.

------------------------

* Manage the daily operations of the boutique and ensure smooth functioning.
* Maintain store cleanliness, product displays, and overall presentation.
* Ensure adherence to company policies, store timings, and operational procedures.
* Handle customer complaints and resolve issues professionally.

2. Sales and Customer Service

* Achieve monthly sales targets and improve overall store performance.
* Assist customers in selecting outfits, fabrics, designs, and accessories.
* Build strong customer relationships and encourage repeat business.
* Follow up on customer enquiries, orders, alterations, and custom stitching requirements.

* Allocate daily responsibilities and monitor staff performance.
* Train employees on product knowledge, customer service, and sales techniques.

* Maintain accurate records of stock receipts, sales, returns, and transfers.
* Coordinate with suppliers for purchasing, replenishment, and timely delivery.
* Conduct periodic stock verification and report discrepancies.
* Minimise stock loss, wastage, and damage.

5. Billing and Financial Management

* Supervise billing, cash handling, POS operations, and daily sales closing.
* Maintain daily sales reports, expense records, and cash reconciliation.
* Monitor sales performance, operating expenses, and profitability.
* Coordinate with the accounts team regarding collections, payments, and financial records.

6. Marketing and Business Development

* Support promotional activities, festive offers, and seasonal sales campaigns.
* Coordinate social media promotions, product photography, and new collection launches.
* Help develop the boutique's customer base through referrals and client follow-ups.
* Monitor market trends, competitor activities, and customer preferences.

7. Custom Orders and Coordination

* Coordinate customer measurements, design selections, stitching, alterations, and delivery schedules.
* Monitor the progress of customised orders and ensure timely delivery.
* Coordinate with designers, tailors, vendors, and management to maintain product quality.

A Sales Officer at AgeWell is generally responsible for increasing product sales, developing new customers and distribution channels, maintaining relationships with existing clients, and achieving monthly sales targets. 1. Job responsibilities

· Achieve daily, weekly and monthly sales targets assigned by the sales manager.

· Identify new business opportunities in the assigned territory.

· Visit potential customers and explain the company's products, benefits and pricing.

· Generate new leads and convert them into regular customers.

· Develop relationships with distributors, dealers, retailers and other business partners.

· Follow up on quotations, purchase orders and pending sales opportunities.

B. Market visits and distribution

· Conduct regular field visits according to the sales plan.

· Identify new outlets and expand product distribution.

· Ensure product availability and visibility at retail outlets.

· Check stock levels, product movement and market demand.

· Coordinate with distributors to ensure timely delivery and replenishment.

· Collect feedback about competitor products, pricing and promotional activities.

C. Customer relationship management

· Maintain good relationships with existing customers.

· Respond to customer questions, complaints and product-related concerns.

· Follow up with customers to encourage repeat orders.

· Maintain accurate records of customer interactions and sales activities.

· Coordinate with internal departments to resolve order or delivery issues.

D. Sales reporting and administration

· Prepare daily sales reports and submit them to the reporting manager.

· Track sales achievements against monthly targets.

· Maintain customer databases, visit reports and order records.

· Report market trends, competitor activities and customer feedback.

· Monitor outstanding payments and coordinate collection follow-ups according to company policy.

· Attend sales meetings and product training sessions.

2. Daily activities of a Sales Officer

A typical working day may look like this:

Morning

Planning and review

Review targets, pending orders, customer appointments and the day's route plan. Daytime

Field sales and customer visits

Meet customers, explain products, generate orders, develop new accounts and check stock availability. Afternoon

Follow-ups and business development

Contact prospective customers, follow up on quotations and coordinate deliveries or payment follow-ups.

Evening Reporting

Update sales records, calculate target achievement and prepare the next day's plan.

3. Qualifications and skills required

· Education: A bachelor's degree in business, commerce, marketing or a related discipline may be preferred.

· Experience: Field sales or business development experience is useful; the exact requirement depends on the vacancy.

· Mobility: Willingness to travel within the assigned territory, if field visits are required.

***Who We Are***

At SOTI, we are committed to delivering best\-in\-class mobile and IoT device management solutions. We are looking for out\-of\-the\-box thinkers that appreciate the art of creating great software. To us, being visionary is more important than doing things the way they have always been done.

***What We’re Looking For***

The Customer Bug (Jira) Analysis Team is a team within SOTI's Executive Escalations team that consists of team members with intensive EMM (SOTI MobiControl) product knowledge, proven customer\-facing, troubleshooting and escalations experience. Also skilled with deep\-level analysis of JIRA tickets. The team’s main function is to thoroughly analyze, debug, and provide fixes or workarounds to incoming JIRA tickets before reaching the core development team. The contribution of this team will in turn result in high\-quality bug tickets that truly need code fixes and will also alleviate workloads from developers. Software Analyst is responsible for reviewing and troubleshooting JIRA tickets coming from various departments such as the Technical Support team, Professional Services, Pre\-Sales, etc. The role involves critical issue analysis and research, testing, and advanced\-level troubleshooting techniques. Code referral and fix suggestions are also needed to identify potential bugs and solutions, respectively.

***What’s in it for you?***

*The People* \- From our humble origins in our founder’s basement, to our industry\-leading position today, SOTI has worked hard to foster a company culture that we can all believe in. A culture that emphasizes personal growth, continuous innovation, and fun.

*The Growth* \- Our environment fosters new ideas, fresh perspectives, and the ability to take them over the goal line. SOTI is a fast\-paced environment with a global reach that encourages you to make your mark and be part of something big!

*The Technology* \- You’ll get the chance to work with leading\-edge technologies and take on complex and interesting projects, as part of highly collaborative and agile teams. You will work alongside SOTI’s partners which include leading tech giants that will keep you on the cusp of emerging technologies.

***What You’ll Do***

* Analyzing debug log files and crash analysis, bug identification, suggesting fixes and coordinating with the engineering team to implement the bug fixes in future releases for MobiControl products
* Identifying MobiControl server\-side and client\-side limitations based on information gathered from the customer’s production environment
* Working with internal teams to develop, maintain, and update diagnostic tools internally to check configuration\-related issues and log files for multiple mobile platforms
* Troubleshooting, researching, and coordinating with frontline teams to evaluate the issue and narrow down the process/procedure or method that is causing the failure
* Identifying issues that are caused by the latest operating system or product updates, and coordinating with the engineering team to provide patches for fixing the issues

***Experience You’ll Bring:***

* Degree in Computer Information/Application Systems, Enterprise Computing, Information Technology, or equivalent experience
* Experience: Good to have experience in MDM or software development or related field (Exceptions apply)
* Well\-versed with enterprise MDM solutions and applications
* Knowledge and experience with various mobile platforms such as Android, Android Enterprise, and iOS
* Knowledgeable in Java/Android/Kotlin, C\#, .NET, and development platforms such as Android Studio, and Visual Studio
* Familiar with Git, software development, and the JIRA platform
* Familiar with Agile and project management
* Knowledgeable in SQL, Windows, and server management and administration
* Knowledgeable in networking concepts and various IT architectures and infrastructures
* Excellent critical thinking and troubleshooting skills.
* Experience with building custom applications for various use/business cases
